title: triad leg B — correctness against intent
description: Structured output contract for leg B (codex --output-schema). Mirrors the finding fields in correctness.md — do not add fields here without updating that prompt to match.

status.description: no_ticket: ticket.md was NO_TICKET_PROVIDED, leg skipped. no_findings: reviewed, nothing to report. findings: one or more findings below.

findings.description: Empty for no_ticket and no_findings. One entry per defect for findings, ordered by severity.

trigger.description: The concrete input or sequence that causes it, and the wrong outcome.

spec.description: The ticket line it violates, or "edge case — not in ticket".
